mapper.sql:
WHERE h.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND LOWER(h.name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%'))
AND h.id IN ( SELECT hf.hotel_id FROM hotel_facilities hf JOIN facilities f ON f.id = hf.facility_id WHERE f.name IN
#{name}
GROUP BY hf.hotel_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.name) = #{facilityCount} )
mapper.select:
SELECT h.id AS id, h.name AS name, h.address AS address, COALESCE((SELECT AVG(rv.rating) FROM reviews rv WHERE rv.hotel_id = h.id), 0) AS rating, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews rv WHERE rv.hotel_id = h.id) AS review_count, (SELECT MIN(r.price_per_night) FROM rooms r WHERE r.hotel_id = h.id AND r.status = 'SALE') AS price_per_night, (SELECT hi.image_url FROM hotel_images hi WHERE hi.hotel_id = h.id ORDER BY hi.sort_order LIMIT 1) AS image FROM hotels h
ORDER BY h.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT f.name AS name, f.icon AS icon FROM facilities f ORDER BY f.name
SELECT f.name FROM hotel_facilities hf JOIN facilities f ON f.id = hf.facility_id WHERE hf.hotel_id = #{hotelId} ORDER BY f.name

SELECT h.id AS id, h.name AS name, h.address AS address, h.description AS description, COALESCE((SELECT AVG(rv.rating) FROM reviews rv WHERE rv.hotel_id = h.id), 0) AS rating, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews rv WHERE rv.hotel_id = h.id) AS review_count, (SELECT hi.image_url FROM hotel_images hi WHERE hi.hotel_id = h.id ORDER BY hi.sort_order LIMIT 1) AS image FROM hotels h WHERE h.id = #{hotelId} AND h.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT f.name AS name, f.icon AS icon FROM hotel_facilities hf JOIN facilities f ON f.id = hf.facility_id WHERE hf.hotel_id = #{hotelId} ORDER BY f.name
SELECT hi.image_url FROM hotel_images hi WHERE hi.hotel_id = #{hotelId} ORDER BY hi.sort_order
SELECT r.id AS id, r.name AS name, r.price_per_night AS price_per_night, r.max_pets AS max_pets FROM rooms r WHERE r.hotel_id = #{hotelId} AND r.status = 'SALE' ORDER BY r.price_per_night

SELECT CASE WHEN length(u.name) <= 1 THEN u.name ELSE substring(u.name, 1, 1) || '*' || substring(u.name, length(u.name), 1) END AS reviewer_name, rv.rating AS rating, rv.content AS content FROM reviews rv JOIN users u ON u.id = rv.user_id WHERE rv.hotel_id = #{hotelId} ORDER BY rv.created_at DESC
